transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess what brings me in is… I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I barely talk to people now. I get real flat and quiet, and even starting my cleaning route at work feels like I’m pushing a loaded cart uphill.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can’t hear?

Yeah… sometimes. Usually when I’m mopping after hours, I’ll hear a man’s voice say my name, or tell me I missed a spot. It sounds real clear, like he’s standing over by the stairwell. But when I look, nobody’s there.
Have you ever heard that voice during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

Yes. There was a stretch for a few weeks where I wasn’t feeling as down. I was eating a little better and getting through work more normally. But I still heard my name by the stairwell, and I still felt sure the hallway cameras were being used to keep track of me.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable for several days?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get irritable sometimes, but not like a stretch of days where I’m unusually high or full of energy. I mostly just feel worn down.
For at least two weeks at a time, have you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Yes. It’s been like that for a long while now… about a year and a couple months, I think. It started not too long after I moved, and since then it’s been most days, pretty much.
Was there ever a time when the voice and the feeling of being watched were happening for at least two weeks when you were not feeling depressed at all?

Yes. There were several weeks where I wasn’t really feeling depressed like before. My mood had lifted some, and I was eating and getting through work a little better. But even then, I still heard my name in the stairwell, and I still felt sure the hallway cameras were being used to track me.
When the voice and the feeling of being watched were happening, were you depressed most of the day nearly every day at the same time?

Yes. When I was at my lowest, I was depressed most of the day almost every day, and that was also when I was hearing that man’s voice at work and feeling like people in the building were watching me. I was barely eating, feeling guilty all the time, and sometimes thinking I might not want to wake up.
